answer.label: Whitman — edited wording
answer.sourceLine: Broadview’s edition reproduces Whitman’s 11 May 1846 editorial, but the circulated passage joins separated clauses without an ellipsis and changes “forward with a quarrel” to “forward for a quarrel.” Wikiquote lists the circulating version as disputed. The editorial is real; the supplied wording is not a verbatim continuous excerpt.
